title: デビュー戦の後に・進攻開始

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: At last, my debut is behind us.
choice_data_list: One small step, as they say.
One small step, as they say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed. As of today, we are true contenders in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The stage is set for us to take the Triple Crown. Now, come—show me your strategic acumen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Our path leads to the Classics, but they are still some way off. What races should we attempt in my junior year?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf aims to demonstrate her superiority by deliberately taking the thorniest road—the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Because of that, I don't want her to push herself too hard while she's still in her junior year. The Saudi Arabia Royal Cup seems like a safe choice.
choice_data_list: How about the Saudi Arabia R.C.?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh? How unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I thought you might opt for the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes, or perhaps the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Are they not where the best of the juniors are crowned?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right, but we're already setting our sights high with the Classic Triple Crown. The last thing we need is to make our agenda any harsher.
choice_data_list: We're not trying to be the best of the juniors.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hah… I see. I like the way you think.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then the Saudi Arabia R.C. it shall be.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: With that decided, we should schedule our next—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Patter, patter, patter…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: There she is! Symboli Rudolf! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your debut! Do you have a message for your fans?
choice_data_list: Sorry, we're a little busy right now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I know it, we're being swarmed by reporters. Rudolf needs to rest after her debut, so I try to fend them off, but…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No need to shield me, Trainer. Let me deal with them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course. As I said before the race, the eyes of the world are on us. We mustn't waste that opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I will be happy to take your questions. One at a time, if you please.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I'll start! So, now that you've made your racing debut, what's next for Symboli Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Naturally, I hope to claim the Classic Triple Crown. To that end, I will continue to compete as a junior…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It takes several hours for Symboli Rudolf to answer all of the reporters' questions to her satisfaction. By the time we get back to the academy, it's already evening.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well then, I suppose this is where we part ways.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Rest well, Trainer. You must be exhausted after today.
choice_data_list: I'll walk you to the dorm, at least.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to the dorm. I thought I might attend to some student council business before turning in.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: At this hour. The press interviews concluded earlier than I anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Which is to say, I fully expected to be accosted by reporters after the race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You may not have heard that they were coming, but the members of the press do not always observe proper protocol.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed, many reporters would prefer to hear off-the-cuff reactions rather than prepared responses.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: They will naturally come during the moments after a race, and all the more so when the interviewee puts forward a spotless image.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like she was a lot more prepared than I was. I shouldn't have let myself be caught flat-footed like that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You have nothing to apologize for.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As the public face of the student body, I've had more than my share of dealings with the media.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You too shall get used to them in time, like it or not. After all, you are now the Emperor's gate warden.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But we have strayed off topic. I have work to attend to.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: To be clear, Trainer, I am not exerting myself simply for the fun of it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now that I've made my debut, my schedule will be packed with training and races.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But I have no intention of shirking my student council duties.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The Emperor must be the master of both the pen and the sword, or she is no Emperor at all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: All of which will only be possible if I take care of my health, of course. Rest assured, I will not neglect that either.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, unless I am mistaken, this matter is settled.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I will see you tomorrow. Good night, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, she leaves, and I can't stop her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf is an incredible racer, perceptive about the world around her, and attentive to her own needs. Most of the time, she probably doesn't need me at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I want to do everything I can to make myself useful on the few occasions when she does. Anything to help her achieve her dream!
